name: 1.23.0-beta.17
notes: RPG Maker MZ games: fixed “SecurityError: Failed to construct 'Worker'” when starting (MZ decodes its music in a background worker). Workers now start from the game's own files, and the files they load are answered by the app too.
HTML games wait for the files their scripts asked for before the page counts as loaded, as RPG Maker MZ expects.
